jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
About Wellspring

Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. Founded in 2003, Wellspring has grown to serve over 500 organizations globally, including Fortune 500 companies, SMEs, hospitals, and universities. The company’s flagship products—Evolve, Astria, Sophia & Flintbox—enable organizations to manage the entire innovation lifecycle, from discovery and IP management to commercialization and knowledge transfer.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine of top-of-funnel growth. You will own the full prospecting motion — from identifying and sourcing target contacts to feeding them into multi-channel outbound campaigns, nurturing prospects through early-stage conversations, and converting engagement into qualified pipeline. You will also serve as the first human touch for inbound inquiries, respond quickly to capture intent, and work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to book, run, and advance discovery calls. Your output is measured in Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and pipeline dollars delivered.

Core Responsibilities

As a Solutions Consultant, you are the technical and strategic partner to our enterprise account executives across Europe. You own the "why this matters to you " of every deal — translating a customer's portfolio and innovation challenges into a compelling, credible vision of what Wellspring makes possible, and demonstrating it in a way that moves executive stakeholders to act.

You will spend your time researching accounts deeply, running discovery with senior stakeholders, and building and delivering tailored demonstrations that tell a story rather than list capabilities. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with sales, product, and services to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals inside some of the largest and most sophisticated enterprises in the world.

This is a role for someone who thinks of pre-sales as a craft: part strategist, part storyteller, part domain expert.

What

you'll

do

Research accounts like an analyst. Before a single conversation, build a genuine understanding of the customer's business — their portfolio strategy, product pipeline, organizational structure, public commitments, and the pressures driving their industry. Turn that research into a hypothesis about where Wellspring creates value.
Lead consultative discovery. Run discovery sessions with large, cross-functional groups and senior stakeholders. Ask the questions that surface the real problem beneath the stated one, and earn the right to be seen as an advisor rather than a vendor.
Sell through storytelling. Frame every demonstration as a narrative the customer sees themselves in — anchored to their strategic priorities, their language, and their people. Make the abstract concrete and the complex simple.
Build tailored demos. Design and construct bespoke demonstrations that reflect the specific customer, use case, and stakeholders — not a generic sandbox. Bring account research directly into the demo environment so what the customer sees feels built for them, because it was.
Present to executives. Command a room of senior decision-makers — VPs and C-level in R&D, innovation, engineering, and IT — with credibility, clarity, and presence. Handle hard questions in real time.
Own the technical win. Lead technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and responses to RFPs/RFIs. Address security, integration, and architecture questions in partnership with product and services.
Be a two-way conduit. Bring the voice of the customer back to product and go-to-market teams, and help sharpen how Wellspring positions itself in the strategic portfolio management category.
Travel to where the deals are. Roughly 25% travel across Europe (and occasionally beyond) for key customer meetings, workshops, and events.

What

you'll

bring

Enterprise pre-sales / solutions consulting experience selling complex B2B SaaS to large enterprises, ideally with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
A genuine talent for storytelling and demonstration — you can take a complex platform and make it land as a clear, resonant narrative for a specific audience.
Strong consultative discovery skills — you're comfortable leading conversations with large groups and senior executives, and you listen at least as well as you present.
Rigorous account research habits — you do the homework, and it shows in how tailored and credible your engagements are.
Executive presence and communication — you're persuasive, composed, and clear in front of the most senior people in a customer's organization.
Comfort with technical depth — you can speak credibly about integrations, data, architecture, and security, and know when to bring in specialists.
Awareness of AI and agentic architecture — you don't need to be an expert, but you understand that this is where enterprise software is heading, and you're comfortable holding a credible conversation to that end with both technical and business stakeholders.
A working understanding of API-driven workflows — how data moves from systems of record through integrations to downstream end users.
Fluent English; additional European languages are a strong advantage given the customer base.

Nice to have

Experience in the strategic portfolio management, innovation management, R&D management, or PPM space is a real plus — but it is not required. If you've built deep enterprise SaaS solution-selling experience in an adjacent complex domain, we'll help you learn the category.
Familiarity with one or more of our core verticals: chemical, consumer goods, aerospace & defense, or pharmaceutical.
A background that blends technical and commercial fluency — consulting, product, or a technical discipline paired with customer-facing work.
Experience in Demo2Win or Value Based Selling methodolgies.

Location &

logistics

Remote, based anywhere in Western Europe with reasonable access to an international airport.

You'll work across time zones with a distributed European team and colleagues in North America.

At Finout, we’re not just shedding light on spend—we’re giving companies the power to make smarter, faster, and more strategic decisions about the cloud.

We’re trusted by brands like The New York Times, Wiz, Elastic, SiriusXM
, and Lyft

If you’re looking to build something big, solve real problems, and grow fast -we’d love to meet you.

Our Customer Success team is rapidly growing, and we are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager

jobs.description:
Who we are is what we do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.
Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.
Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50,  Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.
Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

As an HR Implementation Consultant
, you will lead HR implementations, including data migration, across Deel’s suite of HR products (HRIS, Engage, ATS, Workforce Planning and Compensation). You will oversee the full implementation process, ensuring clients’ HR data is accurately transferred, systems are properly configured, and the transition is seamless. You’ll collaborate closely with internal teams and external stakeholders, guiding clients through the setup and migration phases, while offering ongoing support and training.

Responsibilities

Assist new and transitioning clients with the migration to Deel’s HR tools, ensuring a smooth and successful roll-out.

Act as a consultant for client stakeholders to recommend best practices for implementation.

Become an expert user of the Deel HR tools to provide expert guidance on its features and functionalities, including its touch-points with other Deel products.

Using Project Management tools to guide clients through their onboarding journey, including guiding client through the planning phase during the sales cycle

Perform data imports to migrate client data from their outgoing HRIS to Deel HR, ensuring accuracy and data integrity. Plan, validate, and test data transfers meticulously to prevent errors and minimize disruptions.

Safeguard sensitive employee information during migration, complying with relevant data protection regulations.

Collaborate with internal teams, including Onboarding, Sales, Support, Operations, Product, and Engineering, to deliver an optimal HR onboarding experience.

Contribute to the internal development of Deel HR migration processes, including recommended improvements to standard operating procedures and product automation opportunities.

Qualifications

3+ years of SaaS HR implementation experience

Proven expertise in managing and ensuring accuracy of large HR datasets

Fluent in English

Strong project management skills with attention to detail and the ability to plan migrations effectively

Experience with change management in enterprise settings

In-depth knowledge of HR processes, policies, and best practices

Proficient in HR systems and related tools

Passion for empowering customers and colleagues through training and support

Strong customer relationship management skills

Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments

Excellent communicator, able to convey complex ideas clearly and effectively

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.
Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.

Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.

Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.

We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Some things you'll enjoy

Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of  race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email ( recruiting@deel.com ) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. 

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are looking for a Supply Planning Analyst to join our growing Supply Chain team. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Supply Chain, this role owns end-to-end supply planning, from demand forecast collaboration with Finance through replenishment and inventory deployment across our expanding warehouse network. You will serve as the key liaison between Supply Chain and Finance on demand forecasting and help build the planning processes that support our fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary liaison between Supply Chain and Finance to build, validate, and reconcile the demand forecast on a recurring cadence
Own supply planning across our warehouse network, translating the demand forecast into replenishment, purchase, and inventory deployment plans. Keep service levels high while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory
Support the planning and inventory strategy including determining stocking levels, allocation logic, and network flow between facilities.
Support the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process, aligning Supply Chain, Finance, and third-party fulfillment (3PL) partners around a single demand and supply plan
Identify and drive cross-functional projects that improve forecast accuracy, planning processes, and inventory efficiency, ensuring timely execution and measurable results
Generate recurring and ad-hoc forecast, inventory, and planning reports for stakeholders, including Finance and senior leadership
Monitor forecast accuracy, inventory health, and supplier lead times, escalating risks and proposing corrective actions
Maintain data integrity across ERP and planning tools; ensure the demand forecast, financial plan, and supply plan stay reconciled and consistent
Additional duties as assigned

Qualifications

1 - 3 years of experience in Supply Planning, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, or a related field
High proficiency in Excel, with experience building demand forecast and inventory planning models from large raw datasets
Effective cross-functional communicator, able to partner closely with Finance and present forecast and planning insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong business acumen and firm understanding of demand forecasting, S&OP, and inventory management, including replenishment planning, safety stock strategy, and fulfillment operations
Ability to prioritize work in a fast paced, constantly changing business environment
Meticulous attention to detail
Ability to travel as needed
Experience with demand planning tools (such as Netstock) or ERP systems (such as Netsuite) preferred; multi-warehouse or network planning experience a plus
This hybrid opportunity is based out of the NYC office. Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.; we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Compensation And Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $90,000 - $100,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. Develop conceptual urban framework plans, master plans, design guidelines and reports and presentations. Design, promote, or administer government plans or policies affecting land use, zoning, public utilities, community facilities, housing, or transportation. Develop conceptual urban framework plans, master plans, design guidelines and reports and presentations. Assess the feasibility of land use proposals and identify necessary changes. Conduct community outreach, design charrettes, stakeholder interviews and other information gathering meetings. Work towards sustainable site design and Green-build principles. Rendering and visualization tools, including Enscape, D5, Lumion
Working knowledge of zoning codes, land development regulations, and planning approval processes.
Evaluating land use proposals for regulatory compliance and development feasibility

Graphic design skills (hand drawn and computer based).
AutoCAD, Revit, Sketch-up, Rhino, and Autodesk Forma.
Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
LEED-ND principals, Transit Oriented Developments, Grayfields, Borwnfields, waterfront development and New Urbanist communities.
Working on a full range of project phases, including concept development, schematic design, design development, documentation, and construction administration.
Producing urban design deliverables such as master plans, urban frameworks, design guidelines, site plans, and feasibility studies.
Preparing professional-quality digital and graphic presentations suitable for client, public, and agency review
Generating high-level urban design concepts and schemes, from initial conceptual genesis through refinement.
Hand sketching, including:
Manual sketching
Digital sketching (e.g., Procreate or equivalent tools)
Creating 3D urban models and massing studies for planning and design evaluation.
Sustainable design principles, green-building strategies, and environmentally responsible site planning.

The City of Pearland is seeking a GIS Analyst
to join their growing team.

About The City Of Pearland

Pearland is one of the fastest growing cities in Texas due to affordable housing, outstanding schools, safe neighborhoods, and superb quality of life. Ranked as one of the top ten safest cities in Texas, Pearland residents know their families are safe and secure in the community and surrounding areas. Our close proximity to Houston, just a short 20-minute drive to downtown, allows residents to experience all the city has to offer including professional sports, world-class cultural amenities, and recreation. Employees of the City of Pearland use multi-directional communication and cross-functional teams to promote a greater understanding of the organization by employees at all levels. We have created a culture of continuous learning that encourages and supports employee development and growth. Our work environment is one where innovation is not only supported but encouraged.

A DAY IN THE LIFE AS A GIS ANALYST

Skills

A successful candidate will have the ability to apply critical thinking skills and sound judgement while working collaboratively and proactively with colleagues at all levels of the organization to solve problems and find sustainable solutions. As is expected of all City of Pearland employees, any candidate is expected to operate in accordance with the City's Organization Values:

Trust: We build trust by providing excellent service, honoring it through accountability and effective communication.
Respect: We act with kindness and empathy; embracing diversity and inclusion.
Integrity: We are honest, ethical and do the right things for the right reasons.
Teamwork: We are a caring workplace made up of a team working towards a shared purpose. We collaborate and support each other.

About Us

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

The job

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

About You

You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

Bonus

AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

What we offer

Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

About Wellspring

Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. Founded in 2003, Wellspring has grown to serve over 500 organizations globally, including Fortune 500 companies, SMEs, hospitals, and universities. The company’s flagship products—Evolve, Astria, Sophia & Flintbox—enable organizations to manage the entire innovation lifecycle, from discovery and IP management to commercialization and knowledge transfer.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine of top-of-funnel growth. You will own the full prospecting motion — from identifying and sourcing target contacts to feeding them into multi-channel outbound campaigns, nurturing prospects through early-stage conversations, and converting engagement into qualified pipeline. You will also serve as the first human touch for inbound inquiries, respond quickly to capture intent, and work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to book, run, and advance discovery calls. Your output is measured in Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and pipeline dollars delivered.

Core Responsibilities

As a Solutions Consultant, you are the technical and strategic partner to our enterprise account executives across Europe. You own the "why this matters to you " of every deal — translating a customer's portfolio and innovation challenges into a compelling, credible vision of what Wellspring makes possible, and demonstrating it in a way that moves executive stakeholders to act.

You will spend your time researching accounts deeply, running discovery with senior stakeholders, and building and delivering tailored demonstrations that tell a story rather than list capabilities. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with sales, product, and services to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals inside some of the largest and most sophisticated enterprises in the world.

This is a role for someone who thinks of pre-sales as a craft: part strategist, part storyteller, part domain expert.

What

you'll

do

Research accounts like an analyst. Before a single conversation, build a genuine understanding of the customer's business — their portfolio strategy, product pipeline, organizational structure, public commitments, and the pressures driving their industry. Turn that research into a hypothesis about where Wellspring creates value.
Lead consultative discovery. Run discovery sessions with large, cross-functional groups and senior stakeholders. Ask the questions that surface the real problem beneath the stated one, and earn the right to be seen as an advisor rather than a vendor.
Sell through storytelling. Frame every demonstration as a narrative the customer sees themselves in — anchored to their strategic priorities, their language, and their people. Make the abstract concrete and the complex simple.
Build tailored demos. Design and construct bespoke demonstrations that reflect the specific customer, use case, and stakeholders — not a generic sandbox. Bring account research directly into the demo environment so what the customer sees feels built for them, because it was.
Present to executives. Command a room of senior decision-makers — VPs and C-level in R&D, innovation, engineering, and IT — with credibility, clarity, and presence. Handle hard questions in real time.
Own the technical win. Lead technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and responses to RFPs/RFIs. Address security, integration, and architecture questions in partnership with product and services.
Be a two-way conduit. Bring the voice of the customer back to product and go-to-market teams, and help sharpen how Wellspring positions itself in the strategic portfolio management category.
Travel to where the deals are. Roughly 25% travel across Europe (and occasionally beyond) for key customer meetings, workshops, and events.

What

you'll

bring

Enterprise pre-sales / solutions consulting experience selling complex B2B SaaS to large enterprises, ideally with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
A genuine talent for storytelling and demonstration — you can take a complex platform and make it land as a clear, resonant narrative for a specific audience.
Strong consultative discovery skills — you're comfortable leading conversations with large groups and senior executives, and you listen at least as well as you present.
Rigorous account research habits — you do the homework, and it shows in how tailored and credible your engagements are.
Executive presence and communication — you're persuasive, composed, and clear in front of the most senior people in a customer's organization.
Comfort with technical depth — you can speak credibly about integrations, data, architecture, and security, and know when to bring in specialists.
Awareness of AI and agentic architecture — you don't need to be an expert, but you understand that this is where enterprise software is heading, and you're comfortable holding a credible conversation to that end with both technical and business stakeholders.
A working understanding of API-driven workflows — how data moves from systems of record through integrations to downstream end users.
Fluent English; additional European languages are a strong advantage given the customer base.

Nice to have

Experience in the strategic portfolio management, innovation management, R&D management, or PPM space is a real plus — but it is not required. If you've built deep enterprise SaaS solution-selling experience in an adjacent complex domain, we'll help you learn the category.
Familiarity with one or more of our core verticals: chemical, consumer goods, aerospace & defense, or pharmaceutical.
A background that blends technical and commercial fluency — consulting, product, or a technical discipline paired with customer-facing work.
Experience in Demo2Win or Value Based Selling methodolgies.

Location &

logistics

Remote, based anywhere in Western Europe with reasonable access to an international airport.
:25% travel expected for customer meetings, workshops, and events.
You'll work across time zones with a distributed European team and colleagues in North America.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.
Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.
Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50,  Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.
Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

As an HR Implementation Consultant
, you will lead HR implementations, including data migration, across Deel’s suite of HR products (HRIS, Engage, ATS, Workforce Planning and Compensation). You will oversee the full implementation process, ensuring clients’ HR data is accurately transferred, systems are properly configured, and the transition is seamless. You’ll collaborate closely with internal teams and external stakeholders, guiding clients through the setup and migration phases, while offering ongoing support and training.

Responsibilities

Assist new and transitioning clients with the migration to Deel’s HR tools, ensuring a smooth and successful roll-out.

Act as a consultant for client stakeholders to recommend best practices for implementation.

Become an expert user of the Deel HR tools to provide expert guidance on its features and functionalities, including its touch-points with other Deel products.

Using Project Management tools to guide clients through their onboarding journey, including guiding client through the planning phase during the sales cycle

Perform data imports to migrate client data from their outgoing HRIS to Deel HR, ensuring accuracy and data integrity. Plan, validate, and test data transfers meticulously to prevent errors and minimize disruptions.

Safeguard sensitive employee information during migration, complying with relevant data protection regulations.

Collaborate with internal teams, including Onboarding, Sales, Support, Operations, Product, and Engineering, to deliver an optimal HR onboarding experience.

Contribute to the internal development of Deel HR migration processes, including recommended improvements to standard operating procedures and product automation opportunities.

Qualifications

3+ years of SaaS HR implementation experience

Proven expertise in managing and ensuring accuracy of large HR datasets

Fluent in English

Strong project management skills with attention to detail and the ability to plan migrations effectively

Experience with change management in enterprise settings

In-depth knowledge of HR processes, policies, and best practices

Proficient in HR systems and related tools

Passion for empowering customers and colleagues through training and support

Strong customer relationship management skills

Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments

Excellent communicator, able to convey complex ideas clearly and effectively

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.
Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.

Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.

Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.

We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

Willingness and ability to flex across functions — including pre-sales engineering, technical support, and post-sales enablement — as needed by the business.

Previous experience as a founding or early member of a customer success or solutions engineering function at a high-growth startup.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

The job

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

About You

You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

Bonus

AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

What we offer

Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.
